notes.title: Outpath v1.0.9 - New Save & Load System
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since a lot of people had problems with saving and loading, I worked really hard these days on that.

[b]Change Log[/b]
+ A complete new system of saving and loading games.
+ Now a new save file will be created when using the Island Eater.
+ Now auto-save will make a new save file instead of replacing the current one. Can be toggled off in the options menu.
+ Added a manual save game button in pause menu.
+ Now when loading or saving a game, if there is an error. It will create an error text file.
+ Added seaweed in beaches.
+ Increased save slots from 3 to 20.

* Lost barrels and chests now make more noise, and will appear more.
* Fixed One Punch Man achievement.
* Now Chlorophyll Extraction skill will appear in the world instead of Optimization.
* Black screen when entering the game fixed.
* Animals killed by builds now drop bones.
* More rock blocks will appear in biome 2, so more iron.
* Now dashing will reset gravity.
* Crop plots now show the UI correctly.
* Carpenter Workbench now appears in the Research Table.
* Fixed save files having a very bright white color.
* Minor bug fixes.

If you haven't seen it yet, there's a [b]10% launch discount[/b] on the game!

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 8 - October 16th release date! 2 weeks left! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the 8th Outpath devlog really good news!

This has being a long journey of highs and lows but I can finally tell the [b]release date[/b]!

[h1]October 16th 2023[/h1]
[i]Only 2 weeks to go!![/i]

[h3]Don't forget to add Outpath to your [b]wishlist[/b] to get notified![/h3] [i]It will help me a lot[/i] ːwinter2019happyyulː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

I wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt thanks for your patience and support. I'm thrilled to announce that I have completed the content for my game, and I can't wait for you to try it.

I've worked tirelessly to create a world of new experiences for players, and it's almost ready for you to enjoy.

Thank you all for making this possible. I'm excited to hear your feedback and see you dive into Outpath and see what you create, build and do!

I'am keeping some of the latest content under wraps to avoid spoilers and preserve the excitement for your gameplay experience.

[h3]Some FAQ:[/h3]

[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
[i]The game will be available for $15, with localized prices. It will have a 10% discount upon launch.[/i]

[b]How many hours does the game last?[/b]
[i]The game offers around 20-25 hours of constant new content. However, you can keep improving, building, and optimizing infinitely.
[/i]
[b]Is the game complete?[/b]
[i]Yes, the game has enough content to provide a complete experience. Additionally, once it is released, I plan to continue updating, improving, and adding more based on your feedback, as it will be much easier to balance, create, or expand. Your feedback is essential![/i]

Thanks for playing the prologue and the demo, have a nice day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 7 - 1 month until release!🎉🎊
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the 7th Outpath devlog, good news! The game will be officially launch this coming [b]early/mid October 2023[/b]. Only 1 month to go!
I can't say the day because I still need to polish the game before telling the exact day but its in a really good shape!

[h3]Don't forget to add Outpath to your wishlist to get notified! It will help me a lot ːwinter2019happyyulː[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

[h3]I have been working on a lot of things. Here are some I added/changed:[/h3]

Almost all main content is finished! That means once I finish balancing and bug fixing, I will start adding extra secondary content like more decorations, customizations, features, etc. Right now I am polishing the last biome, here is a screenshot of how it looks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/049877f66ccd141f5f41f36d101ab76a71f0c3de.png[/img]

You can now regenerate entire islands! I love this so much because if you don't like how 1 island generated, now you can change it with 1 magic item, the "Island Eater".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/6a003f6703e9195cc2dd70592d06fbe41989b671.png[/img]

I also worked a lot on thinking and coding unique skills to a total of 50 unique skills! They work so well together that I love how well they turned out.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2024986142286808432/26962BD3294646EC993E8C5025732D87B040783B/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

I also made like 15 more builds, some of them are in this picture, they have unique effects too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/11dbaaa9cbd479b22652407074cc38ab94628c41.png[/img]

I am working +12 hours each day on this game doing really good progress so don't worry about the state of the game, its more live than ever <3
Some people have already played the [b]beta[/b] and [b]said it way better than the demo[/b]! I hope you will enjoy it as much as me ːwinter2019happyyulː

For now the game doesn't have combat and I might stick with it until release. I might add it later on like with an update but I am not sure since I really like Outpath having this chill vibe.

Thanks for playing my game, have a nice day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː

Dynamic weather! For now the weather will change everyday. I wish I had more time to work on this because it really adds a lot to the game. I want to add events like full blood moon nights or raining stars, things like that. If you really like the game I will make a Weather Update improving it<3

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 5 - Decoration, Paint and Synergies 🏡🎨
notes.content:

Materials! You can change the materials of your builds with the chisel, this improve a lot the customization of your bases. Its really cool and satisfaying to use and play with!
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2024981155782209934/72C93F8FC10709BB26136E19B41AAB5C709947DC/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

Paint! Some materials can be painted with the new [i]Universal Paint[/i]. You can remove paint with the water bucket.

Synergies! Now some builds can have synergies. This means new recipes will appear if they are build next to each other!

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 2 - Building & much more! 🏠💤
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I am back!

Welcome to the second Outpath devlog, I will be showing the progress I am doing until the final game is released! This means the things I show here won't be in the demo but in the final game.
ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

[h3]I really appreciate a wishlist so you get notified once the game is released ːwinter2019happyyulː[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

I have been working on a lot of things thats why it took me 2 months to do the next devlog. Here are some things I added/changed:
[list]
[*]You can now build your own structures like houses, rooms and much more! I want to add a lot of decorations to unlock so you can decorate your islands as you wish![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/cc97a77001cfc53811babfb2b119aaf538460bdf.png[/img]
(This one is ugly but you get the idea)
[list]
[*]I changed the building menu to the botton to centrilize everything more.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/16782f723894f6de0ec90bb9f59595879d379758.png[/img]
[list]
[*]I added a new stamina/energy system to the game, adding a layer of survival to the game but not affecting too much the gameplay as many of you asked. Stamina decreases by swimming or breaking stuff, food restores it. Energy is the max stamina you can have and can only be restored by sleeping in beds or consuming some powerful foods.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/73c817dd39eb0005498ee492041c5c442c8a487e.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Now you can swim in the sea. You will use stamina and max energy so becareful! If I have time, maybe I can add something underwater...[/list]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2040732890694037102/AC428F69DD48AE3667D947099C40EFF48E6E0FE9/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
[list]
[*]You can now pin recipes![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/0e36c37cb68c9f002fc5714885bc5f996874051e.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New changes to environment like dynamic clouds/weather, new island generation system & new light system (everything work in progress). I had to upgrade it but I am still not happy how colors and the general vibe feels so I will keep working on this.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/31f27237eaeb6f60e420b135b9841faab1926202.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Now you can swap items in the hotbar, so no more 'Unquip' & 'Equip' to reorganize your hotbar.[/list]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2040732890694039949/E26C5EDEBCC04FE0DDFB99E20FFED39DCEC04B35/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
[list]
[*]I added beds to the game, you can restore energy and time will move faster.[/list]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2040732890694044859/C72253F7016721560EDF78E8D9CA57CE66C5D517/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
[list]
[*]I changed the research menu so its more intuitive. There are only 4 recipes showing but there will be more.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/e31df76e4b8383b4dd71e4cc843930c49301eab4.png[/img]
[list]
[*]I also changed the skills menu to show them better.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/0de6e4aa8b237d6f36a6dfcb6b498ff4d213ce04.png[/img]
[list]
[*]I added jars to the world which will spawn in different parts. Those contain the skills you can upgrade later with credits. To break them, you will have to give resources.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/a065f68ea00c2a5024c1cc8be5721fd52aed76f9.png[/img]
[list]
[*]And finally I changed the inventory menu so more items can appear (still work in progress and not happy with how it is).[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/490a46785bc3accdae3ac505397456cf70075949.png[/img]

Thanks for playing the game, have a nice day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː
